task: Independent hostile audit of C12 Fig. 5p IGF1+CCL2 interaction claim
status: completed internal audit; biological interpretation remains conditional

claims.statement: On the declared linear score e=(MFI-clodronate mean)/(vehicle-control mean-clodronate mean), the half-dose IGF1+CCL2 sample mean exceeds the full-dose Bliss upper bound by 0.0948325 of the control-clodronate gap, or 269188.98 raw MFI. The score capped at the observed control has 0.0677156 surplus.
claims.status: internally reconstructed; conditional on monotone single-agent dose response, this chosen scale, and a Bliss independent-action null
claims.falsifier: A same-dose population estimate under the predeclared linear-gap Bliss null at these half doses is at or below its Bliss prediction; more generally, failure to reproduce the excess under correctly matched single-agent half-dose groups defeats the current ceiling argument.
claims.next_gate: Treat as a response-scale-specific marker result. Do not promote to a biological mechanism or stem-cell function claim.

claims.statement: The positive linear-gap Bliss sign is invariant under every strictly increasing transformation when the same observed control remains the full-response endpoint, because the pair sample mean is above that control. The interaction margin is not invariant: capped surplus is 0.06772 linear, 0.03675 log, and 0.05058 square-root response units. A monotone bounded saturating scale with an unmeasured asymptote yields combo minus Bliss of -0.12892.
claims.status: exact mathematical counterexample and invariance proof; scale choice unresolved
claims.falsifier: Empirically validate a natural bounded response scale and response maximum for K15-GFP MFI; no such calibration is present in the cited source data.
claims.next_gate: Report only the chosen scale and keep the alternative transformation as a scope attack, not a preferred model.

claims.statement: A monotone additive-increment model on raw MFI exactly reproduces the observed combination mean using half-dose IGF1 and CCL2 increments that are each below their full-dose single-agent increments. Therefore the current data do not identify a model-free interaction.
claims.falsifier: Measure matched half-dose single-agent outcomes and reject both additive-MFI and declared same-dose Bliss nulls with a preregistered interaction contrast and uncertainty model.

claims.statement: A shared-baseline covariance-aware delta-method contrast against the full-dose linear-gap Bliss ceiling is 269188.98 MFI (SE 60796.92; Satterthwaite df 5.09; approximate two-sided p=0.00655; approximate 95% t interval [113754.53,424623.43]) under independent, approximately normal biological-replicate groups. Source n=4 values per arm do not include sample IDs, so duplicate-unit or within-mouse dependence cannot be checked.
claims.status: internal conditional uncertainty analysis; inferential assumptions are not verified
claims.falsifier: Independent biological replication with identified experimental units yields a confidence interval including zero for the same predeclared contrast.
claims.next_gate: Preserve the conditional calculation; do not substitute source p-values because they test each arm against clodronate.

claims.statement: The point interaction difference between IGF1+CCL2 and CXCL16+CXCL10 is 0.11093 normalized units, but its covariance-aware delta-method estimate has SE 0.05583, approximate 95% t interval [-0.01361, 0.23548], and approximate two-sided p=0.075; pair-specificity is not established.
claims.falsifier: A powered comparison under a predeclared interaction contrast demonstrates a positive pair-by-combination-class difference.
claims.next_gate: Describe one observed positive score and one observed non-positive score; do not infer pair specificity.

known_failures_and_unknowns: MFI is not a measured event probability or stem-cell conversion fraction.
The source provides one monotherapy dose per factor and no half-dose single-agent groups.
Monotonicity from half to full dose is assumed, not measured.
The biological ceiling at the vehicle-control mean is not validated.
The workbook contains no mouse/eye/sample IDs or batch map, so replicate uniqueness and clustering are unverified.
The source p-values are treatment-versus-clodronate comparisons, not interaction tests.
CCL2 may recruit additional monocytic cells, so mechanism independence is not established.
The cytokine rescue arm lacks lineage-resolved durable function measurements.
No priority, novelty, external-validation, or nature-level capability claim is made.

costs_and_interface.computation: Read-only workbook extraction and finite calculations; no external service, wet lab, clinical action, or external message.
costs_and_interface.data_requirement_for_current_result: Four source observations per arm in Figure 5!C55:F63, plus control/clodronate/full-dose monotherapy means.
costs_and_interface.data_requirement_for_exact_same_dose_nul: Population response means at the two half-dose monotherapies, pair, and shared baseline/control, with identified biological experimental units.
